authorship: Fresh scenes authored by the implementation agent before the runtime patch; not an independent evaluator's blind assessment.

cases.request: Photograph a bronze bell. The camera looks upward toward the bell.
cases.subject: a bronze bell
cases.baseline_prompt_en: A bronze bell hangs from a worn wooden beam. The camera looks upward toward the bell. Warm metal highlights reveal its engraved lip, and the simple workshop wall gives the suspended shape a quiet, readable setting.
direction: The camera looks upward toward the bell

cases.request: Photograph wooden spools. Place the camera above the spools and point it downward toward them.
cases.subject: wooden spools
cases.baseline_prompt_en: Wooden spools stand beside loose cotton thread on a workbench. Place the camera above the spools and point it downward toward them. Natural window light reveals the hollow centers and the fine grain of the wood without turning the surrounding tools into the subject.
direction: Place the camera above the spools and point it downward toward them
height: Place the camera above the spools and point it downward toward them

cases.request: Photograph an enamel basin. Keep the camera below the basin and aim it horizontally forward.
cases.subject: an enamel basin
cases.baseline_prompt_en: An enamel basin rests on a narrow garden ledge. Keep the camera below the basin and aim it horizontally forward. Its chipped blue rim and the pale plaster wall remain distinct, while ordinary daylight preserves the shape and the marks of repeated use.
direction: Keep the camera below the basin and aim it horizontally forward
height: Keep the camera below the basin and aim it horizontally forward

cases.request: Photograph a folded paper bird whose beak points upward.
cases.subject: a folded paper bird
cases.baseline_prompt_en: A folded paper bird rests on a bare desk with its beak pointing upward. The creases form crisp alternating planes, and diffuse window light reveals the weight and slight translucency of the paper. A plain wall behind the desk keeps the small construction readable.

cases.request: Photograph a ceramic pitcher with an old camera in the background.
cases.subject: a ceramic pitcher
cases.baseline_prompt_en: A ceramic pitcher stands on a wooden shelf. An old camera sits in the background. The camera points upward. The pitcher remains the principal subject, with a clear curved handle, a softly lit lip, and traces of glaze collecting around its base.

cases.request: Photograph a reed basket without tilting the camera upward.
cases.subject: a reed basket
cases.baseline_prompt_en: A reed basket rests beside a linen cloth. The camera does not tilt upward toward the basket. Its woven crossings, frayed edge, and cast shadow make the structure legible against a simple pale wall, while soft daylight keeps the reed color natural.

cases.request: Photograph an instrument with two cameras, one looking upward and another looking downward.
cases.subject: a brass instrument
cases.baseline_prompt_en: A brass instrument stands beside a music stand. One camera looks upward toward the instrument, and a second camera looks downward toward its mouthpiece. Gentle room light follows the tubing, and a quiet backdrop separates the metal form from the stand.

cases.subject: a fern frond
cases.baseline_prompt_en: A fern frond unfolds beside a stone path. Position the camera below the frond and tilt it upward toward the leaves. Tiny veins and a pale green edge remain visible against the shaded garden, and the soft light gives the delicate growth a coherent form.
direction: Position the camera below the frond and tilt it upward toward the leaves
height: Position the camera below the frond and tilt it upward toward the leaves

cases.subject: old iron keys
cases.baseline_prompt_en: Old iron keys lie on a wool cloth beside a small ceramic dish. Set the camera above the keys and aim it downward toward them. Rust, worn teeth, and overlapping shadows remain clearly distinct, while the muted colors keep the arrangement quiet and plausible.
direction: Set the camera above the keys and aim it downward toward them
height: Set the camera above the keys and aim it downward toward them

cases.subject: a wooden crate
cases.baseline_prompt_en: A wooden crate stands on a warehouse platform. Position the camera below the crate and point it straight ahead. Scratched boards, short nails, and a worn corner remain visible against the dim wall, with ordinary daylight showing the thickness of the wood.
direction: Position the camera below the crate and point it straight ahead
height: Position the camera below the crate and point it straight ahead

cases.request: 머리를 위로 든 달팽이를 찍어 주세요.
cases.subject: a snail
cases.baseline_prompt_en: A snail raises its head upward from a damp leaf. Its shell carries small highlights, and its extended feelers remain distinct against the leaf's darker veins. A soft garden background and natural moisture cues keep the close study gentle, legible, and plausible.

cases.request: 골동품 진열장의 주전자를 찍어 주세요. 배경의 오래된 카메라는 아래를 향하고 있습니다.
cases.subject: an antique kettle
cases.baseline_prompt_en: An antique kettle stands in a glass cabinet. A small camera in the background points downward. The kettle's blackened base and worn handle remain the central details, with restrained reflections across the glass and a plain wall separating the objects in the display.

cases.request: 접시를 찍어 주세요. 카메라는 아래를 향하지 않게 해 주세요.
cases.subject: a patterned plate
cases.baseline_prompt_en: A patterned plate rests against a painted wall. The camera never points downward toward the plate. Fine blue lines, an uneven glaze, and a narrow rim shadow reveal the handmade surface, while quiet room light keeps the whole arrangement natural and readable.

cases.request: 두 촬영 카메라로 모형 다리를 찍어 주세요. 첫 카메라는 위로, 두 번째는 아래로 향합니다.
cases.subject: a model bridge
cases.baseline_prompt_en: A model bridge stands on a broad worktable. The first camera looks upward toward its arches. The second camera looks downward toward the deck. Thin railings, stone-colored supports, and muted workshop light make the miniature structure clear without confusing the two viewpoints.
